title: Install a planning commit
responsibility: Stage planning files and install a prepared commit while checking the branch and protecting the Git index.

inputs.name: stageFiles.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: stageFiles.files
inputs.description: Map of repository-relative paths to text or bytes.

inputs.name: planCommit.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: planCommit.files
inputs.description: Map of files to materialize and stage.

inputs.name: planCommit.context
inputs.description: Expected parent and branch, prepared commit and temporary directory.

inputs.name: requireLfsFilters.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

outputs.name: stageFiles
outputs.description: Stages safe files in the supplied index, applying Git LFS cleaning to PNG files.

outputs.name: planCommit
outputs.description: Updates files, branch reference and real index after locking; attempts to restore files and the old reference on failure.

outputs.name: requireLfsFilters
outputs.description: Checks Git LFS availability and configured filters using an isolated PNG probe.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Filesystem and command failures can propagate while staging or installing files.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Coded failures include repository-busy, conflict, unsafe-path and git-failed when required LFS filters are unavailable or ineffective.
